featureName.description: The feature name that can be used to get the {@link #sensor} data

sensor.description: Sensor that is the source of data for the data report.

latestValue.description: Latest value in the window {@link SensorDataReport#start} to {@link SensorDataReport#end}

id.description:
When returned by {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun#fetchFeatureDataReport},
this is set to the `sensor.id`. Otherwise, it is unset.

dataset.description: The dataset for which this report was created.

trainingMetrics.description: Metrics for the training period of the {@link #dataset}

validationMetrics.description: Metrics for the validation period of the {@link #dataset}

title: Contains metrics about a particular feature in a specific dataset, split across training and validation periods.
name: FeatureDataReport
